item.title: 日本の超党派国会議員団が中国訪問、政治対話再開へ手探りの一歩
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 日本の超党派国会議員団は24日、4日間の日程で中国を訪問する。同国政府の反発を招いた昨年の高市早苗首相の台湾を巡る発言で日中関係の緊張が続く中、政治対話の再開へ手探りの一歩となる。

訪中計画を知る関係者によると、議員団は中国共産党中央対外連絡部の幹部との面会や経済界との交流を行う予定。

高市首相が昨年11月、台湾有事の際に自衛隊を派遣する可能性を示唆する発言をして以来、最大の貿易相手国である中国との関係は悪化している。高市氏の発言に対し中国は、日本が地域に軍事的脅威をもたらしていると非難し、自国民に日本への渡航を控えるよう呼びかけた。

中国政府はこのほか、民生・軍事の双方に利用可能なデュアルユース品目の輸出規制を強化した。

今回の訪中については、日本テレビなど報道各社が既に報じている。議員団には、自民党の橋本岳衆院議員や中道改革連合の伊佐進一衆院議員が含まれる。橋本氏は6月にもサプライチェーン関連のイベントに出席するため北京を訪れている。

伊佐氏はX（旧ツイッター）への投稿で、日中関係は「1972年以来の最悪の状態」にあるとし、政府間だけでなく、経済、文化、青少年の交流も「すべてがストップ」していると記した。

伊佐氏は、この状況が続くことは、日中双方にとって「決して国益に資するものではありません」と投稿。「両国の対話の窓口は必要ではないかと、同僚議員と議論する中で、訪中して意見交換を進めることを中国に提案することになりました」と説明した。

調査会社ユーラシア・グループの中国・北東アジア担当シニアアナリスト、ジェレミー・チャン氏は、「今回の議員団の訪問で日中関係が大きく改善するとは思わないが、中国の当局者が緊張緩和への道筋を慎重に探っていることは、間違いなく前向きな兆候だ」との見方を示した。

さらに「中国政府にとって日本への圧力が裏目に出ており、高市氏が少なくともあと1年は首相にとどまる可能性が高いことを暗に認めたとも考えられる」と語った。

item.title: Xpeng's robotics unit valued at over $6.3 billion after record funding round
item.description: Chinese automaker Xpeng said on Monday its robotics unit had raised more than $900 million in its first funding round, setting a new record for a single private financing in China's embodied AI sector.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chinese automaker Xpeng (9868.HK) said on Monday its robotics unit had raised more than $900 million in its first funding round, setting a new record for a single private financing in China's embodied AI sector. The funding round, led by IDG Capital and backed by strategic investors Tencent (0700.HK) and Alibaba (9988.HK) , values the robotics business at more than $6.3 billion, Xpeng said in a statement. The proceeds will be used to develop robotics hardware and software, train and refine physical AI models, collect high-quality data, build end-to-end mass-production facilities, and support global expansion, the company said. Xpeng plans to begin mass production of its humanoid robot, Xpeng IRON, by year-end, with initial deployments at its retail stores and industrial campuses. Commercial sales and deliveries in China and overseas markets are scheduled to begin in 2027. CEO He Xiaopeng [USN:L1N42I051 TEXT:"announced"] in June that he would personally lead the robotics business as the electric vehicle maker, seen as one of the leading automaker-backed developers of humanoid robots, pushes towards mass production. The robotics sector has attracted growing interest from automakers, which see parallels with intelligent vehicle development, including expertise in sensors, software, batteries and supply-chain management. In April, Shanghai-based embodied AI startup TARS Robotics raised more than $455 million in a pre-A funding round, a deal that was then billed as the largest single private financing in China's embodied AI sector.

item.title: Geschäft mit Immobilienfinanzierung im Aufwind
item.description: Das Geschäft mit Immobilienfinanzierungen und besonders bei Gewerbeobjekten hat zuletzt spürbar angezogen. Die im Verband deutscher Pfandbriefbanken (vdp) zusammengeschlossenen Institute vergaben im ersten Halbjahr 2026 deutlich mehr Immobiliendarlehen als im Vorjahreszeitraum. Die Zusagen legten um 8,5 Prozent auf 80,4 Milliarden Euro zu, wie der vdp am Montag mitteilte. Der Löwenanteil entfiel dabei auf Wohnimmobiliendarlehen: Ihr Volumen belief sich im ersten Halbjahr auf 50,1 Milliarden Euro, ein Plus von 5,3 Prozent im Vergleich zum Vorjahreswert. Eine weit stärkere Wachstumsrate in Höhe von 14,3 Prozent wiesen Gewerbeimmobiliendarlehen auf: Ihr Volumen summierte sich von Januar bis Juni 2026 auf 30,3 Milliarden Euro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Das Geschäft mit Immobilienfinanzierungen und besonders bei Gewerbeobjekten hat zuletzt spürbar angezogen. Die im Verband deutscher Pfandbriefbanken (vdp) zusammengeschlossenen Institute vergaben im ersten Halbjahr 2026 deutlich mehr Immobiliendarlehen als im Vorjahreszeitraum. Die Zusagen legten um 8,5 Prozent auf 80,4 Milliarden Euro zu, wie der vdp am Montag mitteilte. Der Löwenanteil entfiel dabei auf Wohnimmobiliendarlehen: Ihr Volumen belief sich im ersten Halbjahr auf 50,1 Milliarden Euro, ein Plus von 5,3 Prozent im Vergleich zum Vorjahreswert. Eine weit stärkere Wachstumsrate in Höhe von 14,3 Prozent wiesen Gewerbeimmobiliendarlehen auf: Ihr Volumen summierte sich von Januar bis Juni 2026 auf 30,3 Milliarden Euro. Der Zuwachs speiste sich von Januar bis Juni vor allem aus der Entwicklung bei Finanzierungen für Handelsgebäude, die im Jahresvergleich um 40,6 Prozent auf 9,0 Milliarden Euro anstiegen. Die Wachstumsraten bei der Darlehensvergabe für Büroobjekte (14,8 Milliarden Euro) und für Hotels (2,4 Milliarden Euro) betrugen 9,6 beziehungsweise 9,1 Prozent. Das Neugeschäft bei Industriegebäuden (0,5 Milliarden Euro) und bei sonstigen gewerblich genutzten Objekten (3,6 Milliarden Euro) war dagegen rückläufig im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025. "Das Immobilienfinanzierungsneugeschäft der Pfandbriefbanken weist für das erste Halbjahr 2026 Zuwächse auf, die Entwicklung in diesem Geschäftsfeld verläuft solide", betonte Jens Tolckmitt, Hauptgeschäftsführer des vdp. Die Darlehensvergabe liege jedoch weiterhin deutlich unterhalb der Volumina, die vor der Zinswende erreicht worden seien. Für das zweite Halbjahr 2026 rechnet er unter den gegebenen Rahmenbedingungen allenfalls mit leichten Anstiegen des Neugeschäfts. Es sei davon auszugehen, dass sich die geopolitischen Unsicherheiten, die Konjunkturschwäche und die weiter angespannte Lage auf dem Wohnungsmarkt auch dämpfend auf die Immobilienfinanzierung auswirkten.

item.title: Taïwan sous des pluies torrentielles, quatre personnes portées disparues
item.description: Quatre personnes sont portées disparues après que des pluies torrentielles se sont abattues lundi sur le sud et l'est de Taïwan, entraînant la fermeture des bureaux et des écoles.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Quatre personnes sont portées disparues après que des pluies torrentielles se sont abattues lundi sur le sud et l'est de Taïwan, entraînant la fermeture des bureaux et des écoles. Un système dépressionnaire stagne au-dessus du sud de Taïwan depuis quelques jours, provoquant de fortes pluies et des inondations. Et le gouvernement se prépare à l'arrivée d'un typhon qui devrait frapper l'île en fin de semaine. Les autorités de Kaohsiung, troisième ville taïwanaise avec plus de 2,7 millions d'habitants, ont déclaré qu'elles s'attendaient à ce que les précipitations cumulées sur les cinq jours de présence du système dépressionnaire dépassent 1,3 mètre, soit près de la moitié de ce que la ville enregistre habituellement en une année entière. Les pompiers taïwanais ont déclaré que sur les quatre personnes portées disparues dans les eaux de crue, trois l'étaient à Hualien et une à Tainan. TSMC (2330.TW) , le plus grand fabricant mondial de puces électroniques en sous-traitance, a dit dans un communiqué que toutes ses usines taïwanaises fonctionnaient normalement. L'administration centrale de la météorologie de Taïwan a estimé que le typhon Saudel, qui se dirige actuellement vers la région d'Okinawa, dans le sud du Japon, devrait passer au nord de Taïwan au lever du jour le vendredi avant d'atteindre la côte est de la Chine.

item.title: L'Iran menace de saisir les navires enfreignant ses règles de transit par Ormuz
item.description: L'Iran avertit que les navires ne respectant pas les règles relatives au transit dans le détroit d'Ormuz pourraient faire l'objet de restrictions, notamment d'amendes, d'une détention ou d'une confiscation, selon un message publié sur X par l'Autorité du détroit du golfe Persique (PGSA).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'Iran avertit que les navires ne respectant pas les règles relatives au transit dans le détroit d'Ormuz pourraient faire l'objet de restrictions, notamment d'amendes, d'une détention ou d'une confiscation, selon un message publié sur X par l'Autorité du détroit du golfe Persique (PGSA). Cet avertissement accroît les risques pour les affréteurs et les armateurs dont les navires traversent le détroit d'Ormuz, par où transite en temps normal un cinquième du transport maritime mondial d'hydrocarbures. Le [USN:L8N44L0C1 TEXT:"volume global"] du trafic est faible, selon l'agence britannique Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), et reste inférieur d'environ 90% aux niveaux observés avant le conflit. La PGSA, une organisation nouvellement créée par l’Iran pour gérer le détroit, a invité les propriétaires de cargaisons à consulter une liste actualisée des navires jugés non conformes pour la navigation dans le golfe Persique. Les bâtiments effectuant des opérations telles que des transferts de cargaison de navire à navire ou des transbordements avec des unités non conformes seront également ajoutés à la liste des navires soumis à restriction, a précisé la PGSA. Toute demande de radiation devra être accompagnée d'explications pertinentes aux autorités maritimes iraniennes, précise le message publié sur X.

item.title: Zelenskiy says Russia is 'not ready' for ceasefire on grain ships
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said Russia was "not ready" for a ceasefire on attacks on ships in the Black Sea carrying agricultural produce, as Moscow wants to extend any deal to cover attacks on Russian refineries and pipelines.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said Russia was "not ready" for a ceasefire on attacks on ships in the Black Sea carrying agricultural produce, as Moscow wants to extend any deal to cover attacks on Russian refineries and pipelines. Moscow and Kyiv, major players in global agriculture markets, have accused each other of intensified attacks on vessels used for food exports during Russia's war in Ukraine . Reuters reported this month that Ukraine had sent Russia an [USN:L1N44A0XW TEXT:"offer to halt attacks"] on civilian targets in the Black Sea. [USN:L8N44B0GM TEXT:"Russia dismissed"] the idea, saying it saw no grounds for "half-measures" that would offer a respite to the other side. "I spoke with certain leaders. I proposed that they use their vessels to transport food from our ports, and we would not attack their ships if they came to pick up agricultural exports from Russia," [USN:L8N44L0A5 TEXT:"Zelenskiy"] told journalists in remarks cleared for release on Sunday. He said that Moscow, however, wanted a quid pro quo whereby it would halt attacks on Ukraine's grain corridor if Kyiv halted strikes on Russian energy infrastructure. "For (Russia), it’s not about the grain. It’s exclusively about their energy sector, but the two are not comparable," Zelenskiy said. Any deal to stop Ukraine's strikes on Russian oil refineries and fuel transportation would need to include a reciprocal cessation of attacks on Ukraine's energy system, he said. Russia, which invaded Ukraine in February 2022, did not immediately comment on Zelenskiy's remarks. [USN:S8N43I01K TEXT:"The Kremlin"] said on Monday that measures were being taken to minimise the impact of Ukraine's strikes on Russian grain exports. Ukraine has escalated its strikes on Russian economic targets in recent weeks, including on grain export terminals. Last winter, the harshest of the war, millions of Ukrainians were often left without power and heating as Russia focused its attacks on Ukraine's electricity network, leaving many apprehensive about the months ahead.

item.title: Thaïlande-Des séparatistes soupçonnés d'incendies criminels dans le sud - autorités
item.description: Des bâtiments administratifs, des commerces, des voitures et des poteaux électriques ont été incendiés au cours du week-end par des insurgés présumés, dans plus de 70 localités réparties dans quatre des provinces les plus au sud de la Thaïlande, blessant au moins trois personnes, ont déclaré lundi les autorités.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Des bâtiments administratifs, des commerces, des voitures et des poteaux électriques ont été incendiés au cours du week-end par des insurgés présumés, dans plus de 70 localités réparties dans quatre des provinces les plus au sud de la Thaïlande, blessant au moins trois personnes, ont déclaré lundi les autorités. Selon celles-ci, au moins 78 incidents, dont la plupart ont eu lieu samedi soir, ont été recensés dans ces régions : 40 à Narathiwat, 21 à Yala, 15 à Pattani et deux à Songkhla. D’autres se sont produites dimanche. Aucun groupe n’a revendiqué ces attaques. Le lieutenant-général Norathip Poinok, qui commande l’armée thaïlandaise dans le sud du pays, a déclaré lundi aux médias locaux que les autorités avaient reçu, il y a près de deux mois, des renseignements les avertissant d’attaques contre des bâtiments gouvernementaux, des commerces et des infrastructures électriques. Il a également qualifié ces attaques de réponses à la répression menée contre les insurgés et les activités illicites, notamment le trafic de drogue et la contrebande, qui financent les groupes séparatistes. À Narathiwat, où un couvre-feu a été imposé, une ligne ferroviaire a été touchée par des explosifs, entraînant la suspension du trafic sur ce tronçon. Lors d’une réunion dimanche, le Premier ministre Anutin Charnvirakul a demandé aux forces thaïlandaises d’assurer la sécurité publique. Le sud du pays, à majorité musulmane et d’ethnie malaise, est confronté depuis des décennies à une insurrection visant à obtenir une plus grande autonomie ou l’indépendance. La région faisait partie du sultanat malais de Patani avant que son intégration à la Thaïlande ne soit officialisée en 1909. Plus de 7.800 personnes ont été tuées dans les provinces limitrophes de la Malaisie depuis 2004, date à laquelle la dernière vague d’une insurrection de longue date, menée principalement par le Barisan Revolusi Nasional (BRN), a éclaté. Ces attaques surviennent alors que l'État cherche à relancer les pourparlers de paix avec le BRN, le principal groupe séparatiste en lutte dans la zone. Thanut Suvarnananda, négociateur en chef, a déclaré à Reuters ce mois-ci que Bangkok souhaitait aller au-delà d’un simple échange de concessions visant à réduire la violence et s’attaquer aux griefs politiques, notamment en matière de gouvernance. Les discussions, menés sous l’égide de la Malaisie, ont connu des blocages à plusieurs reprises depuis leur lancement en 2013.

item.title: 原油下落、米国の対イラン計画の詳細発表控え－ブレント93ドル付近
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 24日のエネルギー市場で原油先物は下落。市場は同日中に明らかになる米国によるイランを経済的に孤立させる計画の詳細を待っている。

北海ブレント原油は1バレル当たり93ドル付近に下落。過去2週間では13%程度上昇した。ウェスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）は同86ドル付近。ベッセント米財務長官は、イランに対する圧力を強化する計画の詳細を会見で明らかにする見通しで、CNBCとのインタビューでは、米同盟国に取り組みへの参加を強く促した。

シンガポール時間午後0時2分時点で、ブレント原油10月限は1.4%下げて1バレル＝93.09ドル。WTI10月限は1.6%安の同85.64ドル。

原油は今年、50%超上昇している。6カ月目に入った米国とイランの戦争により、原油や石油精製品の供給は世界的に滞っている。米国にとって、イラン産原油の最大の買い手である中国を標的にして反発を招くリスクを冒す以外に、イランに対する経済的圧力を実質的に強める手段があるのかは明確ではない。

ベッセント氏は英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）への寄稿で、「イランを支える者たちは、同国の石油を購入し、輸送している」と述べ、「彼らは、イランを支え続けることがもたらす結果をよく考えるべきだ」と続けた。

item.title: The week in Asian football
item.description: Talking points from the week in Asian football:
item.dc:creator: Michael Church
item.content:encoded: Talking points from the week in Asian football: RONALDO SCORES FROM BENCH AS AL-NASSR CONTINUE WINNING START Cristiano Ronaldo scored his first goal of the Saudi Pro League season as champions Al-Nassr picked up their second win in a row with a comfortable 4-0 victory over Al-Riyadh on Saturday. Abdulelah Al-Amri and Angelo gave Ange Postecoglou's side a two-goal lead at halftime before Joao Felix added the third and Ronaldo, introduced as a 62nd-minute substitute, completed the scoring seven minutes from time. Al-Hilal sit in second after securing a 3-0 win over Al-Fayha while Al-Ahli thrashed Abha 4-0 and Al-Ettifaq beat Al-Fateh 1-0 to all move onto six points from two matches. MACHIDA DOWN URAWA TO TOP J-LEAGUE WITH PERFECT RECORD Machida Zelvia cruised to a 3-1 win over Urawa Red Diamonds on Sunday to maintain their perfect start to the J-League season with Go Kuroda's side joined at the summit on nine points by champions Kashima Antlers and Kashiwa Reysol. Hotaka Nakamura, Takuma Nishimura and Neta Lavi were on target as Machida won for the third league match in a row to move onto nine points. Kashiwa are second after a 4-2 win over V-Varen Nagasaki while striker Leo Ceara scored at both ends in Kashima's 3-2 victory over Avispa Fukuoka. THRASHING OF ANYANG SEES SEOUL EXTEND K-LEAGUE LEAD FC Seoul handed Anyang FC a 7-0 thrashing on Saturday to increase their lead in the K-League to 13 points over second-placed Ulsan HD, who lost 1-0 to champions Jeonbuk Motors. Moon Seon-min scored twice for the league leaders against Anyang with Hrvoje Babec, Patryk Klimala, Anderson Oliveira, Jeong Seung-won and Lee Seung-mo also on target. Bruno Mota scored the only goal in the 54th minute in Jeonju as Jeonbuk defeated Ulsan to pull level with the title holders on 37 points from 24 matches. CHENGDU SEE LEAD TRIMMED AFTER LOSS IN NINE-GOAL CLASH Chinese Super League leaders Chengdu Rongcheng were on the wrong side of a nine-goal thriller on Saturday as John Aloisi's side lost 5-4 to Shanghai Shenhua to have their advantage at the top trimmed to 12 points from Beijing Guoan. He Yiran had given Chengdu a second-minute lead before Luis Asue levelled 19 minutes later, only for Wellington Silva to put the home side back in front before the interval. Two more goals by Asue either side of He's own goal put Shanghai in control and Xie Pengfei added his side's fifth in the 74th minute before two late penalties from Felipe Silva closed the gap for Chengdu.

item.title: Alibaba cae tras vender acciones por 10.200 millones de dólares para financiar su apuesta por la IA
item.description: Las acciones de la china Alibaba se desplomaban el lunes en Hong Kong después de que la compañía lanzara una venta de títulos por 10.200 millones de dólares con un fuerte descuento para financiar sus ambiciones en inteligencia artificial, mientras los inversores centraban la atención en la dilución de capital y los riesgos de ejecución.
item.dc:creator: Kane Wu, Samuel Shen, Casey Hall
item.content:encoded: Las acciones de la china Alibaba (9988.HK) se desplomaban el lunes en Hong Kong después de que la compañía lanzara una venta de títulos por 10.200 millones de dólares con un fuerte descuento para financiar sus ambiciones en inteligencia artificial, mientras los inversores centraban la atención en la dilución de capital y los riesgos de ejecución. El gigante del comercio electrónico y la computación en la nube dijo que vendería nuevas acciones por 80.000 millones de dólares hongkoneses (10.200 millones de dólares estadounidenses), a 112,70 dólares hongkoneses cada una —un descuento del 8,4% respecto del cierre del viernes—, para financiar chips, infraestructura de IA y modelos de inteligencia artificial. La IA se ha convertido en el principal motor del crecimiento de los ingresos de Alibaba en momentos en que el comercio electrónico se estanca, y sus modelos de IA Qwen figuran entre los más populares de China. Aun así, algunos inversores albergan dudas sobre el éxito que podría alcanzar la empresa. "El ADN de Alibaba está en el comercio electrónico, no en la tecnología avanzada", dijo Yang Tingwu, subdirector general de la gestora de activos Tongheng Investment. "Por mucho que invierta en 'hardware' de IA, es probable que sus competidores la aventajen en innovación tecnológica". Sus acciones en Hong Kong llegaron a caer un 10,5%, aunque reducían las pérdidas por la tarde y cotizaban en línea con el descuento ofrecido. La venta de 710 millones de acciones ordinarias equivale al 3,6% del total ampliado de títulos en circulación. La operación registró una fuerte demanda y atrajo órdenes por 28.000 millones de dólares, incluidos 6.000 millones de inversores con estrategias de largo plazo y fondos soberanos, dijeron tres personas conocedoras del asunto. Alrededor del 40% de la cartera de órdenes se adjudicará a inversores con estrategias de largo plazo y fondos soberanos, entre ellos algunos de los principales fondos soberanos de Europa, Asia y Oriente Medio, dijeron dos de las personas. Entre los inversores figuraban la Autoridad de Inversiones de Qatar (QIA), la noruega Norges y Hillhouse, según una de las fuentes. Alibaba, Hillhouse, QIA y Norges no respondieron de inmediato a solicitudes de comentarios. (1 dólar = 6,7229 yuanes chinos)

item.title: La Nouvelle-Zélande veut interdire l'accès aux réseaux sociaux aux moins de 16 ans
item.description: Le Premier ministre néo-zélandais, Christopher Luxon, a déclaré lundi que son parti allait présenter au Parlement un projet de loi visant à interdire aux enfants de moins de 16 ans d'utiliser les réseaux sociaux, la Nouvelle-Zélande étant le dernier pays en date à vouloir prendre des mesures en la matière.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le Premier ministre néo-zélandais, Christopher Luxon, a déclaré lundi que son parti allait présenter au Parlement un projet de loi visant à interdire aux enfants de moins de 16 ans d'utiliser les réseaux sociaux, la Nouvelle-Zélande étant le dernier pays en date à vouloir prendre des mesures en la matière. Ce projet de loi obligerait les plateformes de réseaux sociaux à prendre des mesures pour vérifier l'âge des utilisateurs, en s'appuyant notamment sur des informations existantes liées aux comptes, la reconnaissance faciale et des documents d'identité numériques. En cas de non-respect de l'interdiction, elles risquent des amendes pouvant atteindre 10% de leur chiffre d'affaires mondial. "Nous ne pouvons tout simplement pas accepter les dommages causés à toute une génération d'enfants néo-zélandais", déclare Christopher Luxon, cité dans un communiqué. "Les réseaux sociaux les exposent à des contenus préjudiciables, à une technologie addictive et à des pressions auxquelles ils ne sont pas préparés à faire face, ce qui affecte leur vie familiale, leur santé mentale, leur sommeil et leur éducation", poursuit-il. En décembre 2025, [USN:L8N3XG02I TEXT:"l'Australie"] est devenue le premier pays à interdire les réseaux sociaux aux moins de 16 ans. Depuis, de nombreux Etats comme le Royaume-Uni, l'Espagne, la Pologne, la Turquie, le Brésil, l'Indonésie ont dit envisager des restrictions similaires. La France est devenue en juillet [USN:L8N43N1SY TEXT:"le premier pays européen"] à avoir mené au bout son processus législatif sur l'interdiction des réseaux sociaux aux moins de 15 ans et la mesure devait entrer en vigueur à la rentrée scolaire de septembre. Mais, il y a dix jours, [USN:L8N44B0VL TEXT:"le Conseil constitutionnel"] a censuré cette loi, jugeant qu'elle portait "une atteinte disproportionnée à la liberté d'expression" et ne garantissait pas le droit au respect de la vie privée. OPPOSITION DE L'UN DES MEMBRES DE LA COALITION AU POUVOIR Malgré l'annonce du Premier ministre néo-zélandais, il n'est pas certain que le projet de loi puisse être adopté par le Parlement, étant donné l'opposition affichée de l'un des partenaires de coalition de Christopher Luxon, le parti populiste de droite New Zealand First. La coalition gouvernementale est composée du parti de droite Le Parti National, dont est issu Christopher Luxon, qui compte le plus de sièges au Parlement, du parti libéral ACT New Zealand et de New Zealand First (Nouvelle-Zélande d'abord), parti fondé en 1993 par Winston Peters, un ancien du Parti National. "Nous sommes préoccupés par ce projet de loi, ainsi que par la direction qu'il prend et la pente glissante sur laquelle une législation de ce type mènera inévitablement notre pays", a Winston Peters, qui est également ministre des Affaires étrangères, dans un message publié sur la plate-forme X. Pour ce dernier, la décision de l'Australie de bloquer l'accès aux moins de 16 ans à des plateformes telles que TikTok, (GOOGL.O) (YouTube) d'Alphabet et (META.O) (Instagram et Facebook) de Meta a été un "échec colossal". Des chiffres du gouvernement australien, ainsi que de nombreuses études indépendantes, ont montré que plus de huit jeunes de moins de 16 ans sur dix étaient [USN:L6N44A0KP TEXT:"encore présents"] sur les réseaux sociaux au cours des trois premiers mois de l'interdiction. "Je ne vais pas prétendre que ce sera simple ni que ce sera parfait. Nous ne parviendrons pas à éloigner tous les enfants des réseaux sociaux. Certains trouveront toujours des moyens de contourner la règle, mais franchement, c'est tout simplement trop important pour ne pas au moins essayer", a dit Christopher Luxon en réaction aux critiques à son projet de loi.

item.title: Europe stitches together plan to close the loop in the fashion industry
item.description: All over the world textile waste is growing faster than anyone can cope with it. The bulk is burned, landfilled or dumped. Less than 1% is recycled into new textiles, and the cost is counted in carbon emissions, polluted waterways, and contamination by chemicals and microplastics.
item.dc:creator: Angeli Mehta
item.content:encoded: All over the world textile waste is growing faster than anyone can cope with it. The bulk is burned, landfilled or dumped. Less than 1% is recycled into new textiles, and the cost is counted in carbon emissions, polluted waterways, and contamination by chemicals and microplastics. Fast fashion and fossil-based polyester are driving the upswing in waste , forecast to rise by over 40% by 2035. It doesn’t have to be this way. Recycling technologies are being developed, but finance, policy and coordination are needed to make circularity bankable so it can scale. Robert van de Kerkhof, chief executive of industry alliance ReHubs worked to get circular textiles on the European Commission’s agenda. “It was very clear that nobody will move if there's no financial incentive – which clearly there is not – or if there's (no) legislative pressure.” That pressure is now taking shape, with expectations resting on mandated separate collection of textiles and extended producer responsibility, whereby producers pay fees to cover the costs of managing the textiles they put onto the market, adjusted for their recyclability. Alongside are export restrictions on unsorted waste and a ban on the destruction of unsold textiles. Some countries in Europe already use EPR systems for textiles including France and the Netherlands, but the EU plans for them to be in place across the bloc by January 2028. H&M told The Ethical Corporation magazine that implementation needs to be harmonised across Europe’s 27 member-states if it’s to drive transformation, but signals suggest some may go their own way. In the U.S., California is the first state to place the onus on textile and apparel companies to take responsibility once consumers are done with their products. Fees are not yet set, but penalties for non-compliance are envisaged at $50,000 a day . Women make clothes for export at a garment factory at the in Nantong, Jiangsu province, China. In large garment-making countries such as China, recyclers can source postindustrial waste as they scale. REUTERS Industry group Fashion Declares! has urged the UK government to follow suit , including developing a digital product passport to determine EPR fees and eventually drive better purchasing decisions for consumers. In particular, it wants the government to remove the de minimis customs threshold for imports, where low-value goods are allowed to enter duty-free. Europe’s Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) will eventually set requirements for durability, repairability and recyclability with minimum recycled content requirements. Recyclers also want to know the regulations will specify closed-loop recycling, as opposed to allowing the recycling of plastic bottles into textiles. “Without the demand signals, you don't have the financiers,” says Peter Majeranowski CEO of U.S.-based chemical recycler Circ. Global non-profit Textile Exchange has been assessing the availability of both pre- and post-consumer textiles and the capacity of recyclers both now and projected in 2030. “When we look at (ESPR) legislation, let's not just set targets without truly understanding the ecosystem and the availability of materials,” says recycling lead Adam Gardiner. Brands need this information too, he adds. “What we hear is they want to set targets but it's very difficult to know what the reality of that ecosystem may be in four or five years.” Without reliable feedstock, textile recycling can’t scale. But the infrastructure to collect, sort and pre-process textiles doesn’t exist at scale either. Another industry group, Fashion for Good, has launched an effort, backed by Adidas, Bestseller and Inditex to address the challenge. It involves the whole ecosystem from sorters to recyclers together with producer responsibility organisations (PROs) that will run EPR systems. What would it cost to scale recycling infrastructure? Modelling by ReHubs and BCG suggests that to get to a tipping point – put at 15% textile to textile recycling by 2035 – could cost between 8 and 11 billion euros in capital investment. That means recycling 2.7 million metrics tons of post-consumer waste, and collecting 8 million tons. Annual operating costs would amount to 5-6.5 billion euros. Circ, co-founded by Peter Majeranowski, has developed a new method for recycling polycotton. Earthshot Prize/Handout via REUTERS Achieving that scale requires the entire industry to move in parallel, says Van de Kerkhof of ReHubs. “EPR needs to be harmonised in order to make it easy, manageable, collectible, (and) the investments need to be orchestrated that you have enough capacities along the value chain.” He notes that European sorters and collectors are struggling financially already. “The market cannot finance this transition fast enough on its own. First-of-a-kind sorting and recycling infrastructure carries technology, volume, offtake and policy risks,” he says. Public and private capital is needed to de-risk investment, so the first industrial projects are bankable, he adds. Other countries are building collection systems. Where there’s already a big garment-making industry, such as in China, recyclers can source post-industrial waste as they scale. But on a recent visit, Textile Exchange’s Gardiner found one company offering doorstep collections of textiles, to achieve collection rates that would be considered a success story in Europe. U.S. waste management group WM is also piloting doorstep collections. “On a broader scale, it's about how can you tap into pre-existing (collection) infrastructure and networks to not have to completely rebuild the wheel,” he suggests. Even with the scale of investment anticipated in Europe, recycled fibres will be at a price premium. Consultancy Systemiq calculated that the cost of recycled polyester is around 2.6 times that of new polyester. That means brands will either have to absorb the costs or pass them on to consumers. ReHubs suggests that for a 10-euro T-shirt made of polyester, that could translate to a 60-cent price increase. Dhaka-based Harnest has creating a Responsible Trims platform, working with recyclers to create labels, elastics and threads. Harnest/Handout via REUTERS Renewcell, a Swedish pioneer of cotton recycling, found brands weren’t willing to pay the premium for its fibres. Filing for bankruptcy in 2024, before it could scale, its chairman Michael Berg said the decision was “a testament to the lack of leadership and necessary pace of change in the fashion industry”. The Ethical Corporation spoke to Renewcell in 2018, when the first fibres were coming off its production line. Back then it flagged the issue of collection and sorting infrastructure. But the business is now back as Circulose (the name of its product) and planning to re-open its Swedish plant. The difference this time is that during the scale-up phase brand partners will pay a license fee to access its fibres: Marks & Spencer, Mango and a former backer H&M are amongst them. For textile-to-textile recycling to scale, brands also need to commit to offtake agreements, and recycling needs to grow in parallel with collection and sorting. “I think of Circ now less as an innovation company and more of a coordination company, where we are building the circular economy. All the ingredients are on the kitchen counter, and we have to put them together to make the final meal,” says Majeranowski of Circ. Manufacturing waste and heavy textile users like hotels and restaurants will be an initial source of recycled materials, ahead of post-consumer recycling, says Majeranowski. “We can’t recycle what isn’t already collected (and) we need to demonstrate to bankers that we have a dependable source.” Circ has set up a “fiber club” to address volume and price considerations by aggregating demand pre-competitively amongst brands to meet minimum order quantities for pilots. They’ve worked with fibre producers Birla and Lenzing, and yarn producers, so brands have the material to work with. Fashion “is a very conservative business: Fiber Club is another way to help them take that first leap,” says Majeranowski. A man sorts offcuts of fabric that will be sold to textile factories before being recycled, in the outskirts of Faisalabad, Pakistan. REUTERS/Fayyaz Hussain In preparation for its first plant, expected to come online in France in 2028, Circ is using demo-level fibres to qualify them with the various spinners, knitters and weavers that brands rely on, creating a library of fabric constructions that buyers can select from. One of the tensions in building circular systems is that sorters and recyclers are dealing with products that were never intended for disassembly or recycling, observes Azra Cevapovic, innovation manager at Fashion for Good. Trims is one often-overlooked area. “Circularity won't scale through fabric alone, and the smaller components are where it usually breaks down,” says Assef Shaikh, chief executive of Dhaka-based Harnest. It’s created what it calls a Responsible Trims platform, working with recyclers such as Indorama and Amber Cycle to create labels, elastics, threads, drawcords and dyed yarns that match the fabrics they’re used with. All the processing stages are carried out under one roof, so it can offer its recycled trims at cost-parity with virgin materials. “We're trying to address a problem in the entirety of a garment,” says Shaikh. “If your elastic (or) your thread is not recycled, then recycling it further (is) a problem,” as additional processing is required. Shaikh advocates for complete mandatory material disclosure across the entire garment and to include trims in EPR calculations to boost textile-to-textile recycling. As a centre of garment manufacture, Bangladesh also has the potential to create a big recycling sector. The U.N. Industrial Development Organisation (Unido) has been working with H&M and Circ, testing its recycling process with H&M suppliers in Bangladesh. The same handful of brands are innovating across the recycling ecosystem, but Majeranowski is optimistic that more will join them. “The rest are watching closely, and I think will follow very quickly.” The disruption to supply chains by recent geopolitical events is having an impact, he says. “Circularity is really now about resilience and insurance.” This article is part of The Ethical Corporation's in-depth briefing on the circular economy. item.title: La Norvège forera dans l'Arctique quel que soit l'avis de l'UE-ministre de l'Énergie
item.description: La Norvège poursuivra le développement de ses ressources pétrolières et gazières en mer de Barents, malgré le soutien de l’Union européenne à un moratoire sur les hydrocarbures arctiques, et ne se considère plus comme la "batterie verte" de l'Europe, a déclaré à Reuters le ministre norvégien de l'Énergie, Terje Aasland.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Norvège poursuivra le développement de ses ressources pétrolières et gazières en mer de Barents, malgré le soutien de l’Union européenne à un moratoire sur les hydrocarbures arctiques, et ne se considère plus comme la "batterie verte" de l'Europe, a déclaré à Reuters le ministre norvégien de l'Énergie, Terje Aasland. Depuis l'invasion de l'Ukraine par la Russie en 2022, la Norvège est devenue le premier fournisseur de gaz naturel de l'Europe, couvrant environ 30% de la demande en gaz de l'Union européenne et du Royaume-Uni. La production gazière est restée proche de records l’an dernier, tandis que la production pétrolière a atteint son plus haut niveau depuis 2009. Les prévisions officielles indiquent toutefois une forte baisse après 2030, à moins que de nouvelles ressources ne soient découvertes et exploitées. "Dans le contexte géopolitique et sécuritaire actuel, et compte tenu de la situation en matière de ressources, je pense que la poursuite des activités en mer de Barents sert à la fois les intérêts norvégiens et européens", a déclaré Terje Aasland à Reuters avant l’ouverture lundi à Stavanger de la conférence ONS. L’UE soutient actuellement un moratoire sur les nouveaux forages dans l’Arctique pour des raisons environnementales, mais pourrait revoir sa position face aux préoccupations liées à la sécurité énergétique. Le directeur général d’Equinor (EQNR.OL) , Anders Opedal, a estimé que le pétrole et le gaz naturel liquéfié (GNL) provenant de la mer de Barents pourraient être exportés vers d’autres marchés si l’UE refusait de les acheter. "La seule chose qui en pâtira, en réalité, sera la sécurité européenne. Nous avons la flexibilité nécessaire", a déclaré Anders Opedal à Reuters. LA NORVÈGE ENTEND MAINTENIR SES NIVEAUX DE PRODUCTION Selon Terje Aasland, la Norvège entend maintenir sa production et ses exportations de pétrole et de gaz à des niveaux proches de ceux d’aujourd’hui jusqu’en 2035 au moins, la mer de Barents jouant un rôle central. "Si la Norvège veut rester un fournisseur à long terme de pétrole et de gaz pour l’Europe (...), alors l’Arctique doit faire partie de cette discussion", a déclaré le ministre de l’Énergie. La Norvège a souligné que les zones de la mer de Barents ouvertes à l’exploitation pétrolière, comme celles de la mer du Nord, sont libres de glace et donc moins exposées aux marées noires et à d’autres risques environnementaux. Leur exploitation contribue aussi à préserver l’emploi et le peuplement dans le nord du pays, à la frontière russe. Terje Aasland estime que ces arguments sont entendus à Bruxelles, mais souligne que la Norvège reste souveraine dans le développement de ses ressources. "Nous exploiterons ces zones, et il appartiendra alors à l’UE de décider si elle devra instaurer un moratoire sur l’achat de ce gaz ou de ce pétrole", a déclaré Terje Aasland. Le pétrole arctique pourrait être vendu sur les marchés mondiaux, tandis que le gaz pourrait être exporté sous forme de GNL depuis l’usine de Melkoeya LNG d’Equinor (EQNR.OL) , près de Hammerfest, a-t-il ajouté. Le directeur exécutif de l’Agence internationale de l’énergie, Fatih Birol, a lui aussi appelé l’UE à reconsidérer son opposition aux nouveaux projets arctiques, estimant qu’ils pourraient contribuer à la sécurité énergétique. Les détracteurs soulignent toutefois que ces projets prendraient des années à être opérationnels et auraient peu d’effet sur les besoins à court terme de l’Europe. LA "BATTERIE VERTE": "UNE IDÉE ERRONÉE" Outre le pétrole et le gaz, la Norvège produit un excédent d’énergie renouvelable, principalement hydroélectrique, qu’elle exporte vers l’Europe via des câbles électriques. Le pays s’est par le passé présenté comme "la batterie verte" de l’Europe, mais le ministre estime que cette idée est désormais "erronée", car le pays ne peut à lui seul assurer l’équilibre du marché européen de l’électricité. Cette vision a contribué à la construction de nouvelles interconnexions électriques, notamment avec la Grande-Bretagne et l’Allemagne, mais elle a suscité une certaine opposition en Norvège à mesure que les prix de l’électricité en Europe ont augmenté. Une intégration plus poussée au réseau électrique européen a rendu la Norvège plus vulnérable aux fluctuations des prix sur le continent. Terje Aasland a indiqué que la Norvège ne construira pas de nouvelles interconnexions, tout en restant engagée dans une coopération étroite avec l’Europe. Il a appelé les pays européens à renforcer leurs capacités de production électrique stables, fragilisées par la fermeture de centrales au charbon et au nucléaire et par le manque d’investissements. "L'avenir réside dans un système très solide et intégré", a déclaré Terje Aasland. APPEL À LA COUR SUPRÊME Le gouvernement norvégien demandera lundi à la Cour suprême du pays d’annuler une décision de juridictions inférieures ayant invalidé les autorisations de développement de trois champs pétroliers, au motif que leurs conséquences climatiques n’avaient pas été suffisamment prises en compte. L’affaire concerne le champ de Breidablikk, exploité par Equinor (EQNR.OL) , ainsi que les champs de Tyrving et Yggdrasil, exploités par Aker BP (AKRBP.OL) . Les défenseurs de l’environnement estiment que le gouvernement n’a pas pris en compte l’impact climatique lié à la combustion du pétrole et du gaz produits par ces champs, les émissions dites de "Scope 3". Ils contestent également la validité des mesures prises ultérieurement pour remédier à ces insuffisances. L’audience devant la Cour suprême doit durer quatre jours et une décision est attendue plus tard cette année.

item.title: Le Royaume-Uni doit être plus audacieux dans son rapprochement avec l'UE, dit Burnham à Costa
item.description: Le Premier ministre britannique Andy Burnham a déclaré au président du Conseil européen, Antonio Costa, que Londres devrait faire preuve de plus d'audace pour resserrer ses liens avec l'Union européenne (UE), a indiqué lundi son cabinet.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le Premier ministre britannique Andy Burnham a déclaré au président du Conseil européen, Antonio Costa, que Londres devrait faire preuve de plus d'audace pour resserrer ses liens avec l'Union européenne (UE), a indiqué lundi son cabinet. Andy Burnham a déclaré à Antonio Costa que la Grande-Bretagne devait s'appuyer sur la coopération existante en matière de défense et de sécurité avec ses alliés européens et chercher à renforcer la collaboration dans l’ensemble de ses relations, a ajouté le 10, Dowing Street. Les deux hommes se sont rencontrés dimanche soir alors que le Premier ministre britannique se rendait à Kyiv pour coprésider une réunion de la "Coalition des volontaires" pour sa première visite en Ukraine. Le Royaume-Uni "doit se montrer plus audacieux pour se rapprocher de l'Union (européenne)", a indiqué une porte-parole du cabinet d'Andy Burnham à propos des entretiens entre les deux dirigeants. "Cela implique notamment de s'appuyer sur les liens étroits déjà tissés entre le Royaume-Uni et ses alliés européens en matière de défense et de sécurité afin de renforcer la coopération dans tous les domaines de cette relation." Le Royaume-Uni s'efforce d'améliorer ses relations commerciales avec l'UE depuis l'élection d'un gouvernement travailliste en 2024. Les lents progrès ont fait émerger des frustrations de part et d'autre quant aux attentes de Londres. Une porte-parole du gouvernement britannique a indiqué qu'Andy Burnham et Antonio Costa étaient convenus que le sommet Royaume-Uni-UE prévu plus tard dans l'année offrirait une bonne occasion de poursuivre ce travail.

item.title: Looming US sanctions on Iran put China oil buying in spotlight
item.description: China has for several years been the biggest buyer of Iranian oil, putting its purchases in the spotlight as the U.S. threatens heavy economic sanctions on Tehran.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China has for several years been the biggest buyer of Iranian oil, putting its purchases in the spotlight as the U.S. threatens heavy economic sanctions on Tehran. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was scheduled to hold a press conference at 1 p.m. EDT (1700 GMT) on Monday. Following are key details on China's oil trade with Iran, which last year averaged 1.4 million barrels per day, according to ship-tracking firm Kpler. HOW MUCH OIL DOES CHINA CURRENTLY BUY FROM IRAN? Less than it used to. The U.S. renewed its blockade of Iran's ships and ports on July 13 in an attempt to cut off oil sales as a deal to halt their war broke down, throttling[USN:L1N44I07T TEXT:"Iranian exports"]. There have been no visible crossings of the Strait of Hormuz since then, according to Kpler data, although many vessels turn off their location transponders, making them difficult to track. Shipments fell to 785,000 barrels per day in June, the lowest since February 2023 and probably rose in July to 823,000 bpd, but the intake so far in August has dropped to 534,000 bpd, provisional Kpler data showed. WHO ARE THE CHINESE BUYERS? Chinese independent refiners have been the main Iranian crude buyers, attracted by what has typically been a steep discount to mainstream barrels. China's big state refiners have shunned Iranian oil since 2019, when the U.S. reimposed sanctions on Tehran, and China's official customs data does not show any purchases of Iranian crude. Iranian oil delivered to China has long been branded as Malaysian, and more recently Indonesian, and is settled in Chinese currency, trading in a tight loop involving a chain of difficult-to-track intermediaries, refinery sources and traders involved in the business have said. HAVE PREVIOUS U.S. SANCTIONS BEEN EFFECTIVE? Washington has intensified its efforts to clamp down on Chinese purchases of Iranian oil since President Donald Trump returned to the White House early last year, imposing sanctions on mostly smaller Chinese refiners and other participants in the supply chain, which have in some cases proven [USN:L4N3QZ0M3 TEXT:"disruptive"]. The U.S. Treasury Department has also warned two larger Chinese banks they could face secondary sanctions if Iranian funds were found moving through their systems, but has stopped short of designating them. In April, Washington imposed sanctions on [USN:L1N417112 TEXT:"Hengli Petrochemical (Dalian) refinery"], along with about 40 shipping firms and vessels, accusing Hengli of buying billions of dollars worth of Iranian oil, escalating its efforts to curb Tehran's oil revenue. Hengli has denied buying Iranian oil. However, sanctions themselves have done little to slow overall flows of Iranian oil into China. China's Iranian oil imports stood at 1.24 million and 1.58 million bpd in January and February, respectively, Kpler data showed. WHAT DOES CHINA SAY? China, which has said it rejects unilateral sanctions, has called for a resolution through diplomatic and political means.

item.title: Taïwan-Neuf personnes inculpées pour avoir exporté des serveurs d'IA vers la Chine
item.description: Le parquet taïwanais a annoncé lundi avoir mis en examen neuf personnes, dont des employés de Nvidia et de Super Micro , accusées d'avoir exporté illégalement vers la Chine des serveurs d'intelligence artificielle (IA).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le parquet taïwanais a annoncé lundi avoir mis en examen neuf personnes, dont des employés de Nvidia (NVDA.O) et de Super Micro (SMCI.O) , accusées d'avoir exporté illégalement vers la Chine des serveurs d'intelligence artificielle (IA). Taïwan, puissance majeure de l'industrie des semi-conducteurs, est le principal producteur mondial de puces avancées utilisées dans l'IA. Cette année, la justice a enquêté sur des soupçons d'exportation illégale de serveurs équipés de puces Nvidia visées par les restrictions américaines à l'exportation. Washington interdit depuis 2022 l'exportation ou la vente de ces semi-conducteurs en Chine. Dans un communiqué, les procureurs de Keelung, dans le nord de Taïwan, ont indiqué que les prévenus, dont l'identité n'a pas été dévoilée, étaient "pleinement conscients" des "procédures de contrôle internes strictes" de Nvidia et Super Micro en matière d'exportation. Les accusés se sont "entendus à différents niveaux afin de réaliser d'importants profits, en exportant illégalement des serveurs haut de gamme, augmentant les coûts de conformité aux règles des entreprises concernées et portant gravement atteinte à l'image internationale de Taïwan", ont-ils ajouté. Nvidia et Super Micro n'ont pas immédiatement répondu aux demandes de commentaire. Taïwan a renforcé ces dernières années ses contrôles à l'exportation afin d'empêcher le transfert vers la Chine de technologies et de savoir-faire avancés. Pékin considère l'île, gouvernée démocratiquement, comme faisant partie de son territoire, ce que rejette le gouvernement taïwanais.

item.title: Home fans hurt by fireworks thrown by Feyenoord supporters
item.description: Dutch side SC Cambuur said fans suffered burns, hearing damage and eye injuries after visiting Feyenoord supporters threw fireworks during Sunday's league match in Leeuwarden.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dutch side SC Cambuur said fans suffered burns, hearing damage and eye injuries after visiting Feyenoord supporters threw fireworks during Sunday's league match in Leeuwarden. The match was halted for around 20 minutes in the first half when fans in the away section lit large numbers of red flares and threw fireworks. Some were aimed towards sections of the ground containing Cambuur supporters while one exploded on the pitch just a few metres from Feyenoord goalkeeper Tjark Ernst. "Our own goalkeeper had a flare fired at him and only just managed to avoid it,” said Feyenoord general manager Robert Eenhoorn, describing the incident as “simply terrible”. Cambuur said in a statement on Monday that five fans were confirmed to have been injured and that the club would work with the authorities to make sure those responsible were caught. “It should be clear that setting off and firing fireworks is completely unacceptable and has no place in a football stadium whatsoever," the club added. Leeuwarden mayor Foort van Oosten also condemned the incident and promised an investigation, while the Dutch football association said it would revisit its protocols for incidents of disorder. The game resumed despite the injuries to the supporters but it would have been abandoned had a player or match official been hit. “That doesn’t feel right,” Jan Bluyssen, KNVB manager of professional football competition affairs, told Dutch news agency ANP. “We need to examine whether the protocol is still appropriate and how we might want to adjust it.” Feyenoord won the match 5-2 to maintain their unbeaten start to the new league season, while newly promoted Cambuur have lost all three of their opening matches.

item.title: 紅海のサウジ沖でタンカー被弾し火災、乗組員無事と英機関
item.description: ［カイロ ２４日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［カイロ　２４日　ロイター］ - 英海事機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ）は２４日、サウジアラビアの紅海側の港湾都市ヤンブーの西６３カイリの海上でタンカーが正体不明の飛翔体に被弾し、主甲板で火災が発生したと明らかにした。乗組員は全員無事で、環境への影響は報告されていないとした。

ヤンブーは紅海に面したサウジの主要な石油港。紅海は、イランが事実上封鎖するホルムズ海峡に代わるサウジ産原油の輸出ルートだが、先月、親イラン武装組織フーシ派が、サウジ関連船舶に対する封鎖を宣言した。

item.title: German billionaire Klaus-Michael Kuehne dies at age 89
item.description: German investor Klaus-Michael Kuehne, the controlling shareholder of Swiss logistics group Kuehne + Nagel , has died aged 89, the company said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Ludwig Burger, Friederike Heine
item.content:encoded: German investor Klaus-Michael Kuehne, the controlling shareholder of Swiss logistics group Kuehne + Nagel (KNIN.S) , has died aged 89, the company said on Monday. Kuehne, the grandson of company co-founder August Kuehne, also held major stakes in German groups Lufthansa (LHAG.DE) , Hapag-Lloyd (HLAG.DE) and chemicals trade group Brenntag (BNRGn.DE) as well as bus and train services operator Flix. A dominant figure in global shipping and logistics, he transformed Kuehne + Nagel from a family freight forwarder into one of the world's largest logistics groups and amassed a fortune that made him one of Germany's richest investors. His holdings are worth more than $44.2 billion, according to Forbes. He became CEO of Kuehne and Nagel in 1975 and was the chairman of its board of directors between 1992 and 2011. With strong family ties to northern Germany, Kuehne formed a group of investors that agreed to buy Hapag-Lloyd's Hamburg-based container shipping business from TUI in 2008 to prevent it from getting folded into a global rival. A commanding presence among German family investors, he later acquired 20% of the voting rights in German flagship carrier Lufthansa Group (LHAG.DE) .

item.title: バーナム英首相、ＥＵとの緊密化に意欲 コスタ大統領に表明
item.description: [ロンドン ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ロンドン ２４日 ロイター] - 英首相府は２４日、バーナム首相が欧州連合（ＥＵ）のコスタ大統領に対し、英国はＥＵとの関係強化に向け、積極的に取り組む意向を伝えたと明らかにした。年内に開かれる英・ＥＵ首脳会議がその機会になるとの考えも示した。

バーナム氏は２３日夜、ウクライナを支援する「有志連合」会合の共同議長を務めるためキーウに向かう途中、コスタ氏と会談した。

英首相官邸の報道官によると、バーナム氏は、英国は欧州の同盟国との既存の防衛・安全保障協力を土台に、幅広い分野で連携強化を目指すと表明した。「ＥＵとの関係緊密化に向け、より大胆に取り組む必要がある」と伝えた。

同報道官は「これには英国と欧州の同盟国が既に築いている緊密な防衛・安全保障関係を基盤に、あらゆる分野で協力を深めることが含まれる」と説明した。

また両首脳は、年内に開かれる英・ＥＵ首脳会議がこうした取り組みを継続するための有効な場になるとの認識で一致した。

バーナム氏はキーウへの移動中、ルクセンブルクのフリーデン首相とも会談した。

両首脳は、カナダが支援する多国間の防衛支出金融機関「防衛・安全保障・レジリエンス銀行（ＤＳＲＢ）」や、英国、オランダ、フィンランド、ポーランドが立ち上げた「多国間防衛メカニズム」など、防衛支出を増やすためのさまざまな仕組みについて協議した。二つの枠組みが相互に補完し合う方法について話し合ったという。

item.title: Ucrania quiere la paz, pero no se rendirá, dice Zelenski en el Día de la Independencia
item.description: Ucrania quiere la paz, pero no se rendirá ante Rusia a cualquier precio, afirmó el lunes el presidente Volodímir Zelenski en un discurso desafiante con motivo de las celebraciones del Día de la Independencia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ucrania quiere la paz, pero no se rendirá ante Rusia a cualquier precio, afirmó el lunes el presidente Volodímir Zelenski en un discurso desafiante con motivo de las celebraciones del Día de la Independencia. El primer ministro británico, Andy Burnham, y el presidente del Consejo Europeo, António Costa, se encontraban entre los líderes y dignatarios extranjeros que llegaron a Kiev para asistir a los actos conmemorativos del 35.º aniversario de la separación de Ucrania de la Unión Soviética. Burnham tenía previsto copresidir una reunión de la "Coalición de los Dispuestos" —un grupo de países que respaldan a Ucrania— más tarde ese mismo lunes, durante su primera visita a la capital ucraniana como primer ministro. "Ucrania desea la paz con toda su alma, pero no está dispuesta a rendirse sin más", afirmó Zelenski en un video publicado en Telegram en el que aparece vestido con una camisa tradicional ucraniana bordada en la plaza situada frente al monasterio de San Miguel, de cúpula dorada, en Kiev, donde se exhiben tanques rusos calcinados. Afirmó que la exigencia de Rusia —rechazada en repetidas ocasiones por Ucrania— de que Kiev ceda la parte restante de la región oriental del Dombás que no está en manos rusas tras cuatro años y medio de guerra no bastaría para detener la agresión rusa. "No dejaremos que ellos (los rusos) tomen la iniciativa, que engañen a Europa y al mundo entero haciéndoles creer que solo tenemos que renunciar al Dombás y que todo habrá terminado pronto", afirmó. Cientos de miles de personas han perdido la vida y amplias zonas del territorio ucraniano han quedado devastadas desde que Rusia lanzara su invasión a gran escala el 24 de febrero de 2022. Las conversaciones de paz lideradas por EEUU para poner fin de forma duradera a la guerra se estancaron a principios de este año, ya que Ucrania rechazó las exigencias de Rusia de ceder más territorio, y los combates continúan con intensidad a lo largo de un frente de 1.200 kilómetros. HOMENAJE AL PUEBLO UCRANIANO Los avances de Rusia en el campo de batalla se han ralentizado este año y Ucrania ha recuperado algunos territorios en el sureste. Sin embargo, las fuerzas de Moscú amenazan la estratégica ciudad oriental de Kostantínovka, en la región oriental de Donetsk —que forma parte del Dombás, junto con la región de Luhansk—. Aprovechando la grave escasez de misiles antibalísticos de Ucrania, Rusia también ha intensificado este verano boreal su campaña de ataques aéreos contra ciudades alejadas de la línea del frente. Ucrania también ha intensificado sus ataques de largo alcance contra refinerías e infraestructuras logísticas rusas, con el objetivo de socavar el esfuerzo bélico de Moscú. En homenaje a la población y a los soldados que defienden Ucrania en la guerra, Zelenski también pidió a los aliados que le proporcionaran "todo" lo necesario para detener la guerra. Al instarles a llevar a Rusia a la mesa de negociaciones y a imponerle más sanciones, Zelenski dijo que esperaba que desaparecieran "todas las contradicciones y temores" que Estados Unidos tiene respecto a Rusia. "China no debe seguir callada", añadió. Entre otras personalidades presentes en las celebraciones se encontraban el primer ministro de Luxemburgo, Luc Frieden, la presidenta de Moldavia, Maia Sandu, y el presidente de Estonia, Alar Karis, según informó el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores, Andrii Sybiha, en la red social X, al publicar fotos de los mandatarios a su llegada a la estación de Kiev.

BERLIN, Aug 24 (Reuters) – Combined spending related to old age and illness accounted for around 70% of total social spending in Germany last year, pushing the social budget to a new record high, according to an analysis by the Ifo institute published on Monday.

• Spending related to old age and illness accounted was responsible for over 80% of the real increase in spending since 1992, the analysis found

• The key structural cost driver behind this trend is demographic change, which is exacerbating the shift in the welfare state burden between generations

Show Full Article

• “The social budget is growing faster than GDP, which is why the weak economy is also contributing to the increase in the social budget share,” said Ifo researcher Emilie Hoeslinger

• According to the analysis, social spending rose by 11.5%, or €104 billion ($121.33 billion), between 2019 and 2025, adjusted for price effects

• During this period, the social budget share reached a new record high, rising from 29.6% to 32%

• The main cost drivers are the additional spending for the insured elderly population on illness and care, as well as higher federal pension payments

($1 = 0.8572 euros)

(Reporting by Maria Martinez, Editing by Friederike Heine)

Aug 24 : Juventus manager Luciano Spalletti said new signing Randal Kolo Muani has a lot of work to do if he is to recapture his best form after the French forward failed to shine in their 1-0 win at Frosinone Calcio on Sunday. The 27-year-old has returned to Juve for a second spell after spending half a season on loan at the Turin club last year, signing a five-year contract in a deal worth 38 million euros ($44.35 million) earlier this month. Juve have signed the former Paris St Germain forward as a replacement for Dusan Vlahovic following the Serbian's departure to Besiktas. In his first spell at Juve, Kolo Muani scored 10 goals in 22 appearances before PSG loaned to Tottenham Hotspur for the 2025-26 season.

"Sometimes you think you're at an exceptional level, but then you've left something behind and you have to go and get it back. item.title: Germany's Uniper says it has filled 70% of its contracted gas storage
item.description: Germany's Uniper has filled 70% of its reserved natural gas storage capacity despite wholesale prices over the summer providing few economic incentives in a market made more challenging by the war in Iran, its CEO said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Nora Buli
item.content:encoded: Germany's Uniper (UN0k.DE) has filled 70% of its reserved natural gas storage capacity despite wholesale prices over the summer providing few economic incentives in a market made more challenging by [USN:L8N4480RI TEXT:"the war in Iran"], its CEO said on Monday. An inverted summer-winter spread, where summer prices are above those for winter in the wholesale market, mean there is a lack of incentive to store gas, Michael Lewis told Reuters after signing a [USN:L8N44L08Z TEXT:"gas supply deal with Norway's Equinor"]. "Now that doesn't mean to say we haven't stored any gas. We've filled around 70% of the gas storage that we've contracted," Lewis said. However, the price spread has moved in the right direction over the last few weeks, he added. "So we're in the market every day, we're buying gas, we store it where we think there's a right incentive to do so, and we will continue to do that," the CEO said. As of Thursday, [USN:L8N44I0D1 TEXT:"German storage levels"] were at just over 50% of capacity, compared to 76% a year ago and around 62% in European Union countries, according to transparency platform AGSI. Energy companies and traders usually store gas during the summer months, when prices are lower, but the Iran war has driven up prices, making the storing of gas less lucrative compared to selling it on the market. Uniper on Monday morning signed a 30 terawatt hour (TWh) per year deal for pipeline natural gas imports from Norway with supplier Equinor starting from January 1, 2027, but it will not help with gas storage for this winter, Lewis said. Europe can also count on liquefied natural gas (LNG) to supplement pipeline gas deliveries, but the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, through which 20% of global LNG supply used to pass, has lifted prices around the world. "So of course, that's a challenge. We need a diplomatic solution there, and we will do everything we can on our side to secure gas for our customers," Lewis said.

item.title: Hungarian Gripen jet crashes, no injuries reported, PM Magyar says
item.description: A Hungarian Gripen fighter jet crashed near the town of Szolnok on Monday, with the pilot having successfully ejected from the plane, Prime Minister Peter Magyar said in a Facebook post.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Hungarian Gripen fighter jet crashed near the town of Szolnok on Monday, with the pilot having successfully ejected from the plane, Prime Minister Peter Magyar said in a Facebook post. The cause of the accident was currently unclear, and there were no injuries or casualties, Magyar said. No civilian infrastructure was harmed, he added. The minister of defence was on his way to the scene, and an inquiry into the cause of the accident was underway, Magyar said. "According to a preliminary report, there were no injuries and there was no harm in civilian infrastructure," Magyar wrote on Facebook. "The pilot is in an ambulance, he is alive," Minister of Defence Romulusz Ruszin-Szendi said in a Facebook video. Hungary, a NATO member state, operates 18 JAS 39 Gripen fighter aircraft, based in Kecskemet. In 2015, a Hungarian Gripen [USN:KBN0OQ1N1 TEXT:"crash-landed"] in central Hungary due to a technical fault. The pilot ejected and the jet was later repaired.

KUALA LUMPUR: Indonesia has given Malaysian agencies official permission to enter its airspace to conduct cloud seeding operations, Malaysia's environment minister said on Monday (Aug 24), part of both countries' efforts to combat the haze blanketing the region .  Indonesia has been stepping up efforts to slow the spread of haze caused by forest and land fires across several provinces, which this month led to dozens of school closures, including in neighbouring Malaysia.  Malaysia's national disaster management agency and its meteorological department are currently preparing schedules for cloud seeding operations in shared border locations, Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability Minister Arthur Joseph Kurup said in a statement.  This will be coordinated with the Indonesian military, he said.

Malaysia was also prepared to offer assistance to Indonesia in extinguishing fires, with any specific requests to be brought to Cabinet for further action, said the minister. Kurup said the two countries would be escalating their firefighting and fire prevention programmes ahead of national holidays in the coming weeks, including the Malaysia Day celebrations in Sarawak state on Sep 16. Sarawak, which borders Indonesia's Kalimantan province on Borneo island, has been worst hit by the haze. Six districts in Sarawak recorded unhealthy air pollution index (API) readings on Monday, according to data released by the environment department.  Unhealthy API levels were also recorded in eight other districts across four states on the Malaysian peninsula, the data showed.

item.title: 金が3カ月ぶり高値－米長期債買い戻し拡大受け、ドル安懸念広がる
item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： 金は24日、一時1.2%上昇して1オンス＝4650ドルを上回り、5月半ば以来3カ月超ぶりの日中高値をつけた。米財務省による債券市場への大胆な介入を受け、ドル安への懸念が再燃し、投資家が代替資産に資金を振り向けている。
米財務省が長期国債の買い戻しを拡大すると発表し、国債利回りとドルが低下したことを背景に、金は先週、週ベースで3週連続上昇した。
借り入れコストを直接介入によって抑える米国の取り組みは、ドルへの信認を弱めるとの懸念につながり、相対的に他の投資先の魅力を高めている。金が2025年に65%上昇する一因となった、いわゆる「通貨価値の希薄化（ディベースメント）」を巡るテーマが、再び意識されている。ドル建てで取引される商品相場には、ドル安は追い風だ。
グローバルX
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 金は24日、一時1.2%上昇して1オンス＝4650ドルを上回り、5月半ば以来3カ月超ぶりの日中高値をつけた。米財務省による債券市場への大胆な介入を受け、ドル安への懸念が再燃し、投資家が代替資産に資金を振り向けている。

米財務省が長期国債の買い戻しを拡大すると発表し、国債利回りとドルが低下したことを背景に、金は先週、週ベースで3週連続上昇した。

借り入れコストを直接介入によって抑える米国の取り組みは、ドルへの信認を弱めるとの懸念につながり、相対的に他の投資先の魅力を高めている。金が2025年に65%上昇する一因となった、いわゆる「通貨価値の希薄化（ディベースメント）」を巡るテーマが、再び意識されている。ドル建てで取引される商品相場には、ドル安は追い風だ。

グローバルX ETFのアナリスト、ジャスティン・リン氏は「ディベースメントの見方を背景に、マクロ投資家の資金が貴金属へかなり大規模にシフトする余地があるとみている」と述べた。

ブルームバーグが追跡する金連動型上場投資信託（ETF）の保有量は先週、28トン超増と、1月以来の大幅な増加となった。1月は金相場が急騰し、1オンス＝5600ドル弱の過去最高値を付けた。華僑銀行（OCBC）のストラテジスト、クリストファー・ウォン氏は、金市場に参加する投資家の裾野が広がっていることを示す好ましい傾向だとしている。

ウォン氏は「上昇相場にはまだ継続する余地があるが、最近の急騰を踏まえれば、ある程度の持ち合いとなるのが健全だろう」と述べた。同氏は目先の主なリスクとして、実質金利やドルの再上昇を挙げた。

ブリッジウォーター・アソシエーツ創業者で資産家のレイ・ダリオ氏は21日、リンクトインへの投稿で、米国の債務危機に備えるため、投資家は債券の保有を減らし、資産の最大15%を金に振り向けるべきだとの考えを示した。

金はロンドン時間午前9時10分時点で、0.8%高の1オンス＝4638.84ドルで取引されている。銀は68.90ドルとほぼ横ばいで推移している。

item.title: India rejects Adani-linked offshore funds' requests to settle non-disclosure cases, sources say
item.description: India's markets regulator rejected applications last week from at least three Mauritius-based funds with investments in the Adani Group to settle cases of regulatory violation involving failure to disclose their shareholder details, two sources with direct knowledge of the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Jayshree Pyasi
item.content:encoded: India's markets regulator rejected applications last week from at least three Mauritius-based funds with investments in the Adani Group to settle cases of regulatory violation involving failure to disclose their shareholder details, two sources with direct knowledge of the matter said. Thirteen of the Adani Group's offshore investors have been facing an investigation by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) since Hindenburg Research in 2023 alleged improper use of tax havens by the group, prompting a stock selloff. The group has repeatedly denied wrongdoing, and its shares have since recovered. Indian regulations require that at least 25% of a listed company's shares be held by public shareholders, but Hindenburg alleged the Adani Group breached those rules since some offshore funds with Adani company holdings were related to the conglomerate. Last year, SEBI found two of the 13 [USN:L4N3RL0LB TEXT:"offshore funds"] breached its rules when they failed to disclose their acquisitions of certain Adani stocks exceeding 5% — as was required by Indian regulations — and for impeding investigations. SEBI last week rejected the applications of at least three more of the investors after they disagreed with the regulator over the monetary fine SEBI sought as part of a settlement, the two sources said. Reuters could not ascertain the names of the funds. SEBI did not immediately respond to an emailed Reuters request for comment. As part of the proposed settlement, the regulator sought details of the funds' shareholders, a condition the offshore investors opposed, one of the sources said. A settlement would have allowed the funds to resolve the proceedings without admitting or denying the regulator's findings. The cases could now proceed through SEBI's enforcement process including disclosure of regulatory findings, licence suspension in India and monetary penalties.

item.title: Pakistan's Munir spoke to Trump ahead of Tehran visit, sources say
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump spoke with Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir last week ahead of Munir's trip to Tehran on Monday, according to three Pakistani sources, with one saying the main U.S. request was to use Pakistan's influence to bring Iran back to negotiations.
item.dc:creator: Asif Shahzad, Ariba Shahid, Mubasher Bukhari
item.content:encoded: U.S. President Donald Trump spoke with Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir last week ahead of Munir's trip to Tehran on Monday, according to three Pakistani sources, with one saying the main U.S. request was to use Pakistan's influence to bring Iran back to negotiations. Trump last week warned of economic consequences against [USN:L6N44H0PZ TEXT:"any country"] that provided "any type of lifeline to Iran" as he seeks to isolate the Islamic Republic. Iran has in turn vowed to shut down all oil exports from the Gulf. Last week's call, which has not been previously reported, was initiated by Trump, according to two Pakistani sources. The White House Office of the Press Secretary did not immediately respond to a request for comment. It was unclear what Munir and Trump discussed in detail. Munir arrived in Tehran on Monday accompanied by Pakistan's Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, Pakistan's military confirmed, saying it was "part of Pakistan’s efforts to promote regional peace and stability." Pakistan, which has played a key mediating role between the U.S. and Iran this year, has remained a trading partner of Iran throughout the recent fighting. Munir was expected to meet with people close to Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei on Monday, one Pakistani source said. Another Pakistani government source said while U.S.-Iran tensions were a focus of the visit, Munir was also expected to discuss recent attacks by Iran-aligned Houthi fighters on Pakistan's ally Saudi Arabia as well as the recently signed mutual defence agreement between Pakistan, Turkey and Saudi Arabia. Pakistan's earlier mediation efforts between the U.S. and Iran resulted in an interim peace agreement signed in June. But the Islamabad Memorandum quickly faltered, amid new fighting between Iran and the U.S. that has threatened to spiral into a wider regional conflict in recent weeks. "There is a trust deficit on both sides," a third Pakistani source said about the U.S. and Iran, adding that Munir's aim was to mitigate the lack of mutual trust on Monday.

item.title: 来週の日本国債入札、ベッセント長官に試練－米長期金利に影響も
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 来週実施される2回の日本国債入札が、米長期国債利回りの抑制を図るベッセント米財務長官の取り組みにとっての試練となり得る。

日本の財務省は9月1日に10年債、3日に30年債の入札を行う。世界各国の政府借り入れを巡り、投資家がこれまで以上に高い上乗せ金利を求めているさなかの入札となる。入札で需要の弱さが示されれば、米国債市場に波及する恐れもある。米30年国債利回りはすでに約20年ぶりの高水準付近にある。

国債残高の増大と市場のボラティリティー上昇に投資家が対応する中、米国と日本の債券市場の連動性はここ数年、一段と強まっている。

その一例として、日本の超長期債利回りが昨年急上昇した際、米国債市場にも影響が及んだ。米国の公的債務が40兆ドル（約6365兆円）を超え、借り入れコストも膨らむ中で、悪循環に陥る可能性があり、リスクは現在の方が大きいかもしれない。

野村ホールディングスのシニア金利ストラテジスト、アンドリュー・タイスハースト氏（シドニー在勤）は、「今後の日本国債入札を市場は非常に注意深く見守るだろう」と述べ、「入札が不調に終われば日本国債利回りは上昇し、それによって国内投資家にとって市場の魅力が高まり得る。その結果、米国債利回りにも一段の上昇圧力がかかるだろう」と予想した。

財政懸念が再燃し、ここ数週間は主要国の国債市場で売りが広がっている。米30年債利回りは2007年以来の高水準まで上昇した。ドイツが今月発行した30年国債の利回りは15年ぶりの高水準となった。フランスの借り入れコストも2008年以来の高水準に達し、日本も過去最高に近い水準にある。

岡三証券の長谷川直也チーフ債券ストラテジストは「財政やインフレは、欧米と日本で共通しているテーマではある」と指摘し、日本の金利上昇が米国や欧州など「グローバルに影響する可能性というのはあると思う」と話した。

ベッセント氏は先週、長期国債の買い戻しを拡大する計画を発表し、米国債利回りの押し下げに動いた。その後の米国債相場上昇は長続きせず、利回りは翌日には再び上昇基調に戻った。

item.title: Ukraine wants peace but won't give in, Zelenskiy says on Independence Day
item.description: Ukraine wants peace but will not just give in to Russia at any price, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said in a defiant speech on Monday as foreign leaders gathered in Kyiv to mark its Independence Day celebrations.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Flynn, Anna Pruchnicka
item.content:encoded: Ukraine wants peace but will not just give in to Russia at any price, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said in a defiant speech on Monday as foreign leaders gathered in Kyiv to mark its Independence Day celebrations. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham and European Council President Antonio Costa were among the foreign dignitaries present for celebrations of the 35th anniversary of Ukraine's break from the Soviet Union. Burnham, making his first visit to the Ukrainian capital as prime minister, was due to announce British support to help Kyiv boost its domestic production of long-range missiles. He was also scheduled to co-chair a virtual meeting of the "Coalition of the Willing" — a group of countries backing Ukraine — with French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz. The leaders were expected to discuss Ukraine's request for more air defence systems to stop Russian ballistic missiles pounding Ukrainian cities. Wearing a traditional Ukrainian embroidered shirt, Zelenskiy thanked foreign leaders from Finland, Denmark, Norway, Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia for travelling to Kyiv to show their support. He vowed to find a solution to what he called Russian President Vladimir Putin's "ballistic terror". "Ukraine absolutely wants peace, but it is not ready to simply surrender," Zelenskiy said in a video posted on Telegram, which showed him standing in front of the golden-domed St Michael's monastery. Zelenskiy said that Russia's demand - repeatedly rejected by Ukraine - that Kyiv cede the remaining part of the eastern Donbas area that is not in Russian hands after 4-1/2 years of war would not be enough to stop Russian aggression. "All of this is driven by the manic dream of one person that Ukraine should not exist," Zelenskiy said, in a reference to Putin. "The Kremlin is obsessed with this." ZELENSKIY ASKS FOR MORE MISSILES Hundreds of thousands of people have been killed, and swathes of Ukrainian territory have been laid waste, since Russia launched its full-scale invasion on February 24, 2022. U.S.-led peace talks to bring a lasting end to the war stalled as Ukraine refused Russian demands to cede more territory, and fighting continues along a 750-mile (1,200-km) front line. Zelenskiy highlighted the achievements of Ukraine's defence industry during the war, including strikes with naval drones and mid- and long-range strikes deep inside Russia, but said there was more work to do. He urged Ukrainian arms manufacturer Fire Point to accelerate production of its Flamingo cruise missile to take the fight to Russia this winter. Burnham signalled on Monday he would allow the use of classified British technology for Kyiv to start production of European SCALP long-range cruise missiles by Ukraine. The Kremlin said the use of classified British technology would "add fuel to the fire", and has warned London of "consequences" for supplying drones to Kyiv. TRIBUTE TO UKRAINIAN PEOPLE Russia's advances on the battlefield have slowed this year and Ukraine has recaptured some land in the southeast. But Moscow's forces are threatening the strategic eastern city of Kostiantynivka in the eastern region of Donetsk which forms part of Donbas, together with the Luhansk region. Exploiting Ukraine's critical shortage of anti-ballistic missiles, Russia has also stepped up its campaign of air strikes at cities far from the front line this summer. Ukraine has also increased its long-range attacks on Russian refineries and logistics infrastructure, aimed at undermining Moscow's war effort. Ukraine hit four logistics hubs owned by Russia's second-largest online retailer Ozon in southern Russia in drone strikes on Monday. Zelenskiy said on Saturday that Ukraine's war effort was complicated by a [USN:L1N44K01P TEXT:"$27-billion defence funding gap"] this year. He also warned that Russian could look to mobilise some 300,000 additional troops after parliamentary elections in September. Paying tribute to the people and soldiers defending Ukraine in the war, Zelenskiy called on allies to give it "everything" needed to stop the war. "We are not asking you to fight for us," he said. Urging allies to bring Russia to the negotiating table and hit it with more sanctions, Zelenskiy said he hoped that the United States will lose "all the contradictions and phobias" regarding Russia. "China must no longer remain silent," he added.

item.title: イラン、ホルムズ海峡の違反船に罰金・拘留・没収も
item.description: [２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２４日 ロイター] - イランはホルムズ海峡の通航規則に違反した船舶に対し、罰金や拘留、没収などの措置を科す可能性があると警告した。ペルシャ湾海峡庁（ＰＧＳＡ）がＸへの投稿で明らかにした。

ＰＧＳＡはホルムズ海峡の管理を目的にイランが新設した機関。ペルシャ湾に関連する航行では、貨物所有者に対し、規則違反と認定された船舶の最新リストを確認するよう求めている。

規則違反船との間で船舶間移送や積み替えなどを行った船舶も、制限対象リストに追加するとしている。規則違反船のリストからの削除を求める船舶は、必要な説明を添えてイランの海事当局に申請する必要があるという。

BEIJING, Aug 24 : Alibaba officially rolled out its latest AI video generation-model Wan3.0 on Monday with enhanced capabilities after the Chinese internet giant launched a $10 billion share placement to fund rising AI spending. • The new model can generate 30-second videos from documents, spreadsheets, slides and web pages, Alibaba Cloud said in a post on the WeChat platform. • Alibaba said Wan3.0 had been used in short drama and film production, advertising and marketing, tourism promotion and music video creation since a public beta version was launched on August 6. • The release comes a day after Alibaba announced the share sale, the largest-ever primary follow-on offering by a Hong Kong-listed company, as it ramps up spending in the intensifying global AI race. • Alibaba last week reported a 75 per cent plunge in quarterly earnings from a year ago due to soaring AI-related capital expenditure.

item.title: プルデンシャル生命、自粛以降に不適切金銭受領－担当営業社員は死亡
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： プルデンシャル生命保険は24日、多摩支社に所属していた営業社員が複数の顧客に対し、架空の高金利預金など事実と異なる説明を行い、不適切に金銭を受領していた疑いがあると発表した。

発表によると、同営業社員による不適切な金銭の受領は同社が新規契約の販売自粛を開始した2月9日以降にも発生していた可能性がある。同営業社員は既に死亡しているという。被害件数や金額については同社などが調査中だが、全容把握に向けて情報を集めるために事案を公表することにした。

プルデンシャル生命は1月、100人超の社員や元社員が約500人の顧客から31億円に上る金額を不適切な手段で受け取っていたと発表した。2月9日から新規販売を90日間停止するとしたが、4月には11月5日まで180日間延長すると発表していた。

同社は、一連の不祥事を受けた新規契約の自粛期間中に、このような事案が発生したことについて、「大変重く受け止めており、改めて深くおわび申し上げる」としている。

item.title: 「ギグワークは福祉」、中国教授の発言が炎上 雇用不安映す
item.description: [香港 ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[香港 ２４日 ロイター] - 中国の著名な経済学教授が、単発・短期の仕事である「ギグワーク」を「福祉」の一形態と表現したことが国内世論の激しい反発を招いた。「柔軟な就業」という言葉がネット上で急速に広まり、雇用不安への根深い懸念が浮き彫りになった。

北京大学国家発展研究院の副院長で経済学教授の張丹丹氏は先週、人気経済番組「レッツ・トーク」で、ギグワーカーの社会保障について議論した際、労働経済学の観点では「柔軟性そのものが福祉の一形態だ」と発言した。

正規雇用者が勤務時間の柔軟性と引き換えに年金などの給付を受ける一方、柔軟な働き方をする人は社会保障が手薄になる代わりに、時間をより自由に使えると主張した。

交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）では先週末、張氏は単発・短期労働の厳しい現実を理解していないとの批判が相次いだ。

ある微博（ウェイボ）利用者は「専門家のこうした発言は、安定した仕事を持たない人々の傷口に塩を塗るに等しい」と投稿した。

別の利用者は、配達員や宅配員が絶え間ない重圧にさらされていると指摘。「彼らは毎日、休むこともなく、何を犠牲にしてでもプラットフォームのアルゴリズムと競争している。（柔軟な働き方は）本人の希望ではなく、まさに避けようのない選択だ」と訴えた。

中国では景気が減速し、安定したフルタイムの仕事を見つけにくくなっている中で、同氏の発言は多くの人々の神経を逆なでした。

シンクタンクの中国新就業形態研究センターは、常用のフルタイム契約を結んでいない就業者の数が２０２５年の２億８０００万人から今年は３億２０００万人に増えると推計している。これは中国の都市部労働力の約４４％に当たり、米国の全人口とほぼ同じ規模となる。
